title: White Men Can't Jump
tagline: They hustle the courts of Los Angeles.

    StartersLetter Q quince and cheddar quesadillasGloria wins on foods starting with Q. Quince paste and sharp cheddar in crisp tortillas.How to make it4 large flour tortillas200g vintage cheddar, grated150g quince paste, thinly sliced1 small red onion, finely sliced1 tbsp butter1 lime, cut in wedges1 cup rocket leavesScatter half of each tortilla with cheddar, quince and onion, then fold over.Toast in a buttered pan over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts.Cut into wedges and serve with rocket and lime.Cat in an oven buttermilk biscuitsSidney explains what makes a biscuit. Flaky buttermilk biscuits with honey butter.How to make it300g self-raising flour1 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt100g cold butter, diced, plus 60g soft for the honey butter200ml buttermilk2 tbsp honeyRub the cold butter into the flour, baking powder and salt until it looks like rough crumbs.Stir in the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick, fold twice and cut 8 rounds.Bake close together at 220°C until tall and golden.Beat the soft butter with the honey and a pinch of salt and serve with the hot biscuits.Flamin' Hot Cheetos by the bagCourtside, all afternoon.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Off the GrillHustler's carne asada tacosBilly plays like he can't play. Charred skirt steak tacos with salsa verde.How to make it700g beef skirt steak2 limes, juiced3 garlic cloves, crushed1 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil12 small corn tortillas250g salsa verde1 white onion, finely diced1 cup coriander leavesRub the steak with the lime juice, garlic, cumin, oil and salt and leave at least 30 minutes.Grill on a very hot pan 3 minutes a side, then rest and slice thinly across the grain.Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.Fill with steak, salsa verde, onion and coriander.Stucci brothers meatball heroThe Stucci brothers want their money. Pork and beef meatballs in red sauce on a hero roll.How to make it250g beef mince250g pork mince40g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg30g parmesan, finely grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700ml tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp olive oil4 long crusty rolls150g mozzarella, slicedMix both minces with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic.Simmer gently until cooked through and the sauce is thick.Fill the split rolls with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella and grill until melted.Sweet StuffSlam dunk churros with hot chocolateBilly bets his share that he can dunk. Cinnamon sugar churros for dunking in thick chocolate.How to make it250ml water60g butter1 tbsp caster sugar, plus 100g for coating150g plain flour2 eggs2 tsp ground cinnamon1 L vegetable oil, for frying200g dark chocolate, chopped300ml milk1 tsp cornflourBring the water, butter and 1 tbsp sugar to the boil, beat in the flour until it forms a ball, then beat in the eggs one at a time.Pipe 10cm lengths into oil at 180°C and fry until deep gold.Roll the hot churros in the cinnamon and sugar.Heat the milk with the cornflour and whisk in the chocolate until thick, then serve for dunking.Cold DrinksGloria's sympathy watermelon agua frescaGloria wants sympathy not a glass of water. Watermelon blended with lime and mint over ice.How to make it1kg seedless watermelon, cubed2 limes, juiced2 tbsp caster sugar1 cup mint leaves500ml cold water2 cups iceBlend the watermelon with the lime juice, sugar, water and half the mint until smooth.Strain into a jug and chill.Pour over ice with the rest of the mint.Ice-cold BudweiserFor whoever wins the next game.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
